why: The answer writes the standard element-by-element copy loop for this task, but it has two errors: it never creates copy with new int[data2.length], and the bound i <= data2.length reads data2[data2.length], which throws ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException. New code has to be correct to reach L4, so this is a multistructural answer with an error.

concepts.why: It copies each element into the matching index, but it never creates the new array and runs one index past the end.
It treats length as the last valid index (the everyday counting reading), but the last valid index is data2.length-1.
The init, test and update are well formed, but <= makes one pass too many (the WrongIterationCount error).
The answer declares i as an int but makes no claim about how int works.
